fact.en: Do not confuse Sakas with Kushanas. Sakas (Indo-Scythians) preceded the main Kushana consolidation.

fact.en: The Junagadh inscription is the first Sanskrit inscription, not Prakrit, which is a common UPSC trap.

fact.en: Sakas did not destroy the Mauryan empire; they filled the power vacuum in the Northwest post-Mauryan decline.
